fields.Name: Auth0
fields.Description: Auth0 by Okta. Validates RS256 access/ID tokens against the tenant's public JWKS. Set Domain to your tenant domain (e.g. your-tenant.us.auth0.com), ClientID to the SPA application's client ID, and Issuer to https://<Domain>/ (note the trailing slash).

fields.Name: Microsoft Entra ID
fields.Description: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) via MSAL. Set ClientID to the app registration's Application (client) ID and Issuer to https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenantId>/v2.0. The browser driver reads CLIENT_ID / CLIENT_AUTHORITY rather than the prefixed convention, so it supplies its own catalog mapping.

fields.Name: Okta
fields.Description: Okta Identity Cloud. Set Domain to your Okta org (e.g. your-org.okta.com), Issuer to the authorization server issuer (commonly https://<Domain>/oauth2/default), and ClientID to the SPA application's client ID.

fields.Name: Amazon Cognito
fields.Description: Amazon Cognito user pools. Set Issuer to https://cognito-idp.<region>.amazonaws.com/<userPoolId> and ClientID to the app client ID. Put region and userPoolId in ClientConfiguration so the browser driver receives them.

fields.Name: WorkOS
fields.Description: WorkOS AuthKit (User Management). Issuer is https://api.workos.com/user_management/<clientId> and JWKSUri is https://api.workos.com/sso/jwks/<clientId>. IMPORTANT: AuthKit access tokens omit email by default and MJ resolves users by email, so a WorkOS JWT Template adding the email claim is required — see packages/AuthProviders/WORKOS.md.

fields.Name: Google Identity
fields.Description: Google Identity Platform. Server-side token validation only — MJ ships no browser driver for Google, so this provider verifies Google-issued tokens obtained elsewhere rather than offering an interactive login. ClientVisible is false for that reason; setting it true would render a login button with nothing behind it. Issuer is https://accounts.google.com.
